rules.disease: catatonic disorder due to hepatic encephalopathy
rules.sentence: Coding note: Include the name of the medical condition in the name of the mental disor- der (e.g., 293.89 [F06.1]) catatonic disorder due to hepatic encephalopathy).

rules.disease: catatonic disorder due to another medical condition
rules.sentence: The essential feature of catatonic disorder due to another medical condition is the presence of catatonia that is judged to be attributed to the physiological effects of another medical condition.

rules.disease: catatonic disorder due to another medical condition
rules.sentence: Catatonia can be diagnosed by the presence of at least three of the 12 clinical fea- tures in Criterion A.

rules.disease: catatonic disorder due to another medical condition
rules.sentence: There must be evidence from the history, physical examination, or laboratory findings that the catatonia is attributable to another medical condition (Crite- rion B).

rules.disease: catatonic disorder due to another medical condition
rules.sentence: The diagnosis is not given if the catatonia is better explained by another mental disorder (e.g., manic episode) (Criterion C) or if it occurs exclusively during the course of a delirium (Criterion D).

A variety of medical conditions may cause catatonia, especially neurological conditions (e.g., neoplasms, head trauma, cerebrovascular disease, encephalitis) and metabolic con- ditions (e.g., hypercalcemia, hepatic encephalopathy, homocystinuria, diabetic ketoacido- sis).
